programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Another season of the series taking place in England, in Midsomer and its surroundings.Among the eccentric residents there are Chief Inspector Tom Barnaby (John Nettles), calm and persistent in tracking down crimes, husband Joyce (Jane Wymark) and father Cully (Laura Howard).He is assisted by his assistant, Ben Jones (Jason Hughes).Both detectives solve complicated murder cases that take place in the area.What they learn while conducting investigations sometimes exceeds their wildest expectations Tragedy strikes at Whiteacres Golf Club in Midsomer.An unknown assailant kills local snob Alistair Kingslake.Shortly thereafter, a club member approaches Barnaby and informs him about an illegal gambling game that is popular among golfers.Soon one more person dies.Detectives learn that a mysterious figure in a blue tracksuit has been seen at both crime scenes.Barnaby suspects that the organizer of the game is Mrs.Fountain and her two sons who lend money to gamblers and then attack them when they are unable to pay them back.It soon turns out that he was wrong.
